content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can start setting up a fully functional online store tailored for your digital products without needing Stripe or PayPal. The key is to use a combination of free tools and blockchain-based payment solutions that provide immediate results. By leveraging platforms like Cloudflare for hosting and NOWPayments for automated crypto payment processing, you can establish a reliable sales channel. This approach ensures that you maintain full ownership of your data and products while keeping operational costs low. You have the capability to build an entire e-commerce infrastructure that operates independently of restrictive legacy systems. This immediate action plan sets the foundation for your digital commerce journey, empowering you to sell ebooks, courses, or any digital product you create.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack for digital creators in West Africa consists of several essential components designed for fast deployment and efficiency. Start with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your online store. This allows you to create a persistent online presence at no cost. For backend logic, utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, providing the necessary functionality without server expenses. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders and customer data, ensuring easy access and updates. For product delivery, leverage Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions with a mere 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This stack offers a scalable and sovereign solution to process payments, empowering you to bypass the limitations imposed by traditional payment platforms.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on what truly matters when launching your digital store. Avoid getting bogged down by unnecessary features or long-term strategies that can delay your progress. Start with the core functionalities: hosting, payment processing, and product delivery. Set aside concerns about advanced marketing tactics or expansive inventory management initially. Concentrate on ensuring a seamless transaction process first. Once your store is live and you have processed your first sales, you can then look at scaling your offerings or enhancing your site’s user experience. This lean approach allows you to launch quickly, gather feedback, and iterate based on real user interactions without wasting resources on features you do not need right away.
Take control of your digital commerce today.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, ensure all components of your stack are correctly configured. Start by deploying your online store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Load your digital products and ensure they are linked to your payment processor. Set up NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions by following their straightforward integration guide. Test the entire process with a small transaction to confirm that payments are processed successfully and that products are delivered automatically. Once this is complete, you're ready to promote your store. Use social media or community platforms to drive traffic to your store and attract potential customers. A successful transaction not only validates your setup but also boosts your confidence to expand your business.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

Within the next 24 hours, take decisive actions to establish your digital store. Begin by signing up for GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and set up a basic site template to host your products. Next, prepare your digital products for upload—ensure they are well-formatted and ready for delivery. Configure NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you understand how to manage incoming payments. Test your system thoroughly to catch any issues before going live. Finally, draft a promotional plan to announce your store’s launch. Engaging your network on social media can create buzz and drive initial traffic. These steps are crucial for a successful launch and will set the stage for future growth.
